verdict.rationale: dltHub's Web UI/CLI let engineers monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures, and dlt states 'every run is logged and auditable,' which covers run status/logs, but there is no evidence of row-count reporting per sync or any Slack/email/webhook alerting integration. missing for 10: row counts per sync, Slack alerting, email alerting, webhook alerting integration, and independent confirmation of the monitoring UI in practice.
